name: Jyostna Seelam
bio: As Founder and Chapter Chair, Jyostna establishes the strategic vision, governance, and long-term roadmap for ACM Richmond. She leads the executive committee in cultivating a thriving regional technology ecosystem and serves as the principal emissary to industry executives, academic institutions, and professional societies.

name: Abdul Rasheed Shaik
bio: As Vice Chair, Rasheed supports chapter-wide strategy and operations while overseeing execution across all director portfolios. He represents ACM Richmond in industry and academic engagements, ensures smooth coordination across teams, and provides leadership continuity to drive impactful initiatives.

name: Mr Khadarvali Shaik
bio: As Membership Chair, Khadarvali leads efforts to grow and retain a vibrant ACM Richmond community. He develops outreach strategies to attract professionals, academics, and students, fosters meaningful engagement across member segments, and works to ensure every member finds lasting value in their ACM affiliation.

name: Ankita Banerjee
bio: As Treasurer, Ankita manages chapter finances and compliance, maintains financial records, and coordinates with officers to ensure the chapter remains fiscally responsible and aligned with ACM standards — providing the financial foundation that enables ACM Richmond to deliver free, high-quality programs to the community.

name: Dipanjan Sen
bio: As Chapter Secretary, Dipanjan maintains the official records and correspondence of ACM Richmond, ensuring transparency and institutional continuity. He documents chapter proceedings, coordinates formal communications with members and partner organizations, and manages archival records — serving as the administrative backbone that keeps the chapter's operations running smoothly and accountably.

name: Open Position
bio: The Web Master shapes ACM Richmond's digital identity, overseeing the chapter website's design, content accuracy, and technical performance. This role implements new features, maintains infrastructure, and collaborates with officers to ensure our online presence accurately reflects chapter programs, events, and leadership — keeping Richmond's tech community connected and informed.
